round3.retained_solver_change: Skip friction only when its cone radius and all three accumulated friction impulses are exactly zero. No tolerances, contacts, iterations or sleeping settings reduced.
round3.native_settings: MSVC 19.50.35721, AVX2, LTCG, Release /O2 /Oi /Ot /fp:precise, profiling and debug renderer disabled; GENERATE_DEBUG_SYMBOLS=OFF; /wd4866 /wd4868 for MSVC evaluation-order diagnostics. Same settings in native 3D.

known_gjk_failure.description: Sphere-box raw GJK false negative with analytic overlap 0.1059537489; reproduced in current and untouched c9014297 geometry. Native random test exposes it. The Linux random suite does not generate this case. No test bound relaxed.
